name: source-uv-tile
description: Diagnostic: visualize UV coordinates as color gradient with 4x4 tiling. The uv bake is one vec2; dot() against a basis vector extracts each axis in the masks.

uvMap.note: The texel's UV coordinates as a vec2

tiledU.note: The u coordinate, extracted by dot

outputs.note: Red channel = U coordinate, Green channel = V coordinate, visible as 4x4 tiling gradient
